reviews.text: The A-Team staff are very quick to respond and the job done. Every time Jeff has come out to our house for the A/C he has been very professional. He completly explains what needs to be done and gives an estimate before starting the work. I would highly recommend The A-Team!

I highly recommend A Team and now use them as my A/C specialist.  I had been using another company for well over a decade, however, they seemed more interested in wanting me to replace my old A/C unit $$$$ than fixing it.  Someone recommended A Team to me and what a refreshing and pleasant experience. Brandon came out and gave me an honest assesment and fixed my A/C quickly and at a low cost.  I will be using A Team from now on.

Reach out for desperate ac work and they got fixed up in one day. Brandon was great.  The office people were all over it staying in touch.  Just a great company prices were very good.  I would highly recommend if you need ac work done.  Thanks again for all of your help.

Amazing company!!  They quickly stepped in as  the company we typically use recently experienced unfortunate event. Linda was so very helpful and Jeff-our technician - was able to fix our problem so quickly!  Total pros and will recommend FOR SURE!
These guys and gals do a great job. Very punctual, only sell me what I need and go above and beyond to make sure I am satisfied. Very refreshing.

Love them, love their tech Jeff M. Keeps our old machine working top notch. Been with them for almost 3 years. When we've had emergency issues they came asap to fix it or make it working till they can find part or permanent solution.
Now with a newborn in the house it is one less thing to worry about for sure.

As a retired project manager/superintendent I have dealt with many contractors in my work career, the A-Team is exceptional. They came in, did new HVAC unit, duct replacement and replaced all the air vents and did an air balance all in one full day, the crew was very courteous as we were in the house all day, long with them. Clean up was in a timely manner. I would highly recommend the A-Team For your HVAC replacement and service needs. JRS.
Great people very good at communicating on time and Jeff did an excellent job at a reasonable price

We have been using A Team Heat & Air for all of our AC and Heating needs for well over 10 years. We recommend them to everyone in the area. They are honest, fair and believe in customer service. They are responsive to all calls and their staff takes time to know their clients. I highly recommend this company.
Best experience with air conditioning service!  They were quick, reliable, knowledgeable, and honest!  I really highly recommend!  Family owned and operated with great service.

We have been a client since they replaced our A/C in  2017.  They are a text away and very responsive.  Their yearly maintenance contract is reasonably priced and they do treat your issues with priority.  Customer service is A+.  We highly recommend A Team Heat and Air!

The is company has very fast, reasonable service, did not try to start with a high cost then negotiate down. They were fair priced right off the bat. They replaced my upstairs air conditioner and coil. The price was very reasonable.  I will definately use them again when my down stairs air goes bad. They were  on time and very courteous. They even put down drop cloth so they wouldn’t get my carpets dirty. I would highly recommend their services.
Came out on a Friday evening, had my A/C fixed that night! Great service from Jeff!

A Team Heat &Air had a perfect install on me addition. Brandon was very informative and serviced my main house system while on-site.   It’s been a brutal summer and it’s ran perfect.   He is fair in pricing and will be my AC guy   The Equipment he uses is top brand as well  my energy bill has had almost no change.   Brandon calculated the needs perfect      It’s cool when hot and warm when cool.

Thank You A team and Brandon !!!

Our AC wasn’t working as well as it should have and we called Brandon to come take a look.  We ended up needing to replace a unit but he was able to fix the other one.  A couple years later when the second one needed replacing we called on him again.  They are quick and professional.  I highly recommend, Brandon and his team!

Brandon and his A-Team have been servicing our restaurant for 10 years now. They have been incredible to work with and helped us in many scenarios. They are great to work with. We highly recommend them for all your AC needs.

We have used A Team Heat and Air since we purchased our home in 2011.
They have always fixed our problems and been quick to respond. They gave great advice and were honest. We knew our HVAC system was getting old and they kept it running, until it didn't. It finally did give out in January of this year. They did everything to fix it, and a little beyond. With temps below freezing, we're so glad they replaced the system as promptly as they did.

Brandon, Jason, and Linda are truly awesome folks.

A-team has installed my main HVAC system in spring. Their due diligence was great discussing what needed to be replaced and what is the best value for my situation. Execution within a day and great post check and little fix of drain lines after the install. Unit works great! Thanks to Brandon for oversight from start to end!

A Team Heat and Air, Brandon and Jeff did a fantastic job replacing my system! They are fast and efficient! I am very pleased with their work and the price was great. Thank you A Team Brandon and Jeff.

I checked around with several places and got a wonderful recommendation for A Team from some people that use to work with them.  They know what to do and the best way to do it and the best price for the customer.  They saved me a lot of money.  I recommended them to my neighbor and they have been very pleased with them too.
Brandon was such a help. The administrative gal on the phone was also super kind and helpful. I know two other families that have used and loved this company. Great people.

Have been with this company since their beginning.  Service always great. This week Jeff did a remarkable job.
He is great!  Thanks! LN

Can’t say thank you enough for the professionalism of Brandon and the team for the great service they provided on the new A/C installation job they performed on our home. Prompt in arrival, very accurate in the job and the finished product was amazing as the wife and I are extremely happy. Thank you all so much again as we are ready for the Texas summer heat and beyond. Keep up the great work A Team!!! Jerry - Saginaw, Tx

Been using these boys for home and rentals for years.  Prompt, responsive, fair pricing make them top of the heap.  Started an annual service plan which appears to be an excellent value considering how thorough the work is.  Named "A" Team for a reason.

We have been using A Team since they started operation. Dependable, professional. They installed our replacement HVAC units, wifi connected rheostats and new ductwork. We get 2x a year  preventative maintenance from them. I highly recommend them.
Quick to respond. Found the problem correctly with the AC and fixed it promptly. Highly recommend.

I’ve used this company for years and have recommended them to my friends and family. They are always on time, their work is top notch and they are the nicest people to deal with.  I can’t say enough good things about them.

The A Team serviced our old system for years keeping it going, but this was the year we had to get it replaced. They walked us though what would be the best system for our needs. The install was done in a professional and timely manner. Couldn't have asked for a better team and experience.

Incredibly prompt and excellent service from these guys. The moment I called in I felt like royalty. They were also able to educate me on self-diagnostics and maintenance. Will definitely be using this company again.
I was blown away by the detail and thoroughness of the technician when he did a winter service for my two heat and air systems.  Highly recommend this team.
great service, great communication, great people! would recommend

The entire A Team family makes you feel like family. I’ve never worked with a more dedicated, competent and honest company in my life. They are extremely responsive, prompt and friendly. I’m a customer for life.
A Team is absolutely the best. The techs are so courteous and kind. They get to the appointment on time, do a great job and are very knowledgeable .

I've been working with Brandon for a few years now and it's such a relief to have an honest and reasonable A/C company I can count on.  I have referred Brandon to several others and I highly recommend Brandon and his company for all your heating and A/C needs!
A Team is the best! They’re on time, friendly and do great work. We have them at our home and office.

AC Mechanical is definitely the company to go to for all your ac needs. They are very professional. When I have an issue they respond promptly. Brandon is an easy person to work with. I will always use AC Mechanical.
Its always good to see Brandon and his team working on our AC. He is passionate and always accommodating on the question I ask about my AC system. Thank you for the excellent work.
The A Team is just that!!!  Professional, kind, knowledgeable…. I could go on and on!  I would recommend these guys 1 million percent!  Thank you A Team!!!

Man my a.c went down last night called Brandon he answer at night came out the next morning and got it fixed super professional, reasonable price which is a rare thing today but yeah I recommend these guys to anyone super fast good price and good attitude well thank you me and my family are super happy with yall work
Thank you so much Jason & your crew for the great work on replacing our air conditioner/heating system & ducts/vents.  Also thank you Linda for taking care of the paperwork etc. - Great Job!
Absolutely great service. Very professional service. And I would definitely recommend them to anyone in need of any type of ac service.
It was my pleasure doing business with this company I would refer them to anybody they did a wonderful job
Best AC/Heat company in DFW brandon is great to deal with and very professional.
Excellent service! The best, caring helpful group I have met. If I could give them 10stars, I would! Take care and God Bless A Team😊
We have used A Team for several years / completely honest about what can be done and what needs to be done.  Brandon, Jason and Linda are salt of the earth people and we will always recommend!
They show up when they say they will, explain their findings and fix the issue at a fair price.
Brandon and his team are top notch. Highly recommend them.

Great team
Repairs was fast and efficient
Always come on time
Great service from Brandon
Excellent company fair prices friendly staff. Highly-qualified and recommended.
